title: Chai & Chakkar
one_line: Drop Indian snacks into the dabba, merge two of a kind into a bigger treat, and climb 14 tiers to the Royal Thali before the tilt spills you over.
how_to_play: Move to aim and tap to drop. Two matching snacks merge into the next, bigger one. Keep the pile below the dashed line, watch the bell countdown for the Chakkar tilt, and save the Cutting Chai glass for your biggest snack.
description:
Chai & Chakkar is a physics merge puzzle set in a brass tiffin dabba. Snacks fall from the top, roll and settle like real objects, and every time two of the same snack touch they merge into the next, bigger treat: elaichi becomes rasgulla, kulfi, pani puri, samosa and onwards through vada pav, jalebi, masala chai and masala dosa, all the way to the Royal Veg Thali, the 14th tier and a huge 50,000 point Grand Feast.

A round is simple to start and hard to master. You aim along the top of the dabba and drop the snack you are holding, while a small preview shows what comes next. Plan your stacks so small snacks land beside their twins and chain merges happen one after another: merges inside 1.4 seconds build a combo that adds 25 percent per link. If the pile stays above the dashed line for three seconds, the dabba is full and the run ends.

Twists keep every run different. Every 12 drops the Chakkar bell rings and the whole dabba tilts, shifting the pile. And every 12th drop is a Cutting Chai glass, a wildcard that upgrades whatever snack it touches for double points, or sweeps away small crumbs when it lands on a Royal Thali. Eight more twists can be switched on or off in the menu: Masala Rain lets near-twins merge for three seconds, a Hungry Customer orders a snack and tips you if it arrives within 10 drops, a Hot Tawa pushes snacks off one side, a Tilt Warning tells you which way the next tilt goes, Spilled Chai makes the floor slippery, every 5th level is a Tiffin Boss level with a narrower dabba, a Daily Recipe asks for three snacks at once, and a Mystery Box hides its snack until it lands.

Scores climb through endless levels with a level bar, a personal best, a top 5 list and a daily streak. A Daily mode gives everyone the same drops each day. Four snack packs (veg food, fruits, sweets and cafe) plus a custom 14-item builder let you play with your favourite treats, and a sticker shelf collects every tier you reach. Your run saves itself, so you can close the page and carry on later, and a one-tap Share Score posts a short emoji summary.

The home screen shows the goal and a short looping clip of how to play, and the first game teaches you with four quick notes. Soft tabla-and-drone music changes with the twists, getting spicy in Masala Rain and darker on boss levels, and 18 achievements wait in the menu, from score milestones to serving a Hungry Customer.
controls: Move the mouse or slide a finger to aim, click or lift to drop
Keyboard: Left and Right arrows (or A and D) to aim, Space, Down or Enter to drop
Menu: mode, start level, drop hints, sound, theme, snack packs and scores
Menu > Twists: what is happening now (customer order, next tilt, today's recipe) and an ON / OFF switch for each twist
The speaker button mutes sound, music and vibration; Menu has a separate Music switch
tips: Keep small snacks on one side and big ones on the other so twins meet.
Watch the bell number: a tilt is coming when it reaches 1.
Save the Cutting Chai glass for your biggest snack for double points.
Fast chains of merges build a combo multiplier.
story: Every Indian kitchen has a tiffin dabba packed a little too full. Chai & Chakkar turns that into a calm, quick puzzle: one more drop, one more merge, and a cup of chai to keep you going.

resume.how: the run (score, level and every snack in the dabba) saves after each drop and merge and comes back when the page opens; the home screen has Continue and the menu has Resume and Fresh Start
